signOut.title: Sign out?
signOut.body: Your cards stay in bunq. Scan your Pass to open them again.

pairingKey.title: Pair your Pass
pairingKey.body: Enter this Pass’s 64-character application pairing key. VaultPass saves it securely on this phone after a verified signature.
pairingKey.tapPrompt: Hold your Pass near the phone to pair it

language.title: Language
language.body: Choose the app’s language. “Phone language” follows your phone’s settings.
